name: DoctorNVDA
author: Chai Chaimee
description: DoctorNVDA is a diagnostic and recovery utility for NVDA. It recovers frozen speech, analyzes crash logs, isolates faulty add-ons, backs up and restores settings, exports system info, and cleans temporary cache files to maintain screen reader stability. Hot Keys: ALT+Windows+D Single Tap : open DoctorNVDA menu Double Tap : Restart NVDA Tripple Tap : Restart NVDA with add-ons disabled ALT+Windows+R Single : Emergency Synthesizer Reboot, force-reinitialize the speech synthesizer and audio output Double : Crash Log Analyzer collapsed
